model.cost_formula: tax on realized gains (30% short-term, 20% long-term) + savings interest foregone (4.5% APY x 90/365) + dividends forgone on sold lots + securities-backed line interest (7% APR x 90/365) + card interest (0% for 60 days, then 24% for 30 days) + fees
model.risk_formula: 5% of any shortfall below $2,000 of cash above the savings floor + extra interest if every credit APR rises 5 points + $150 margin call if a 30% market drop pushes the securities-backed line over 50% loan-to-value of the pledged lots
model.fitness_formula: fitness = -(modeled cost + lambda x risk penalty), lambda = 1. Mean over a split's scenario variants.
